# Internet Of Learning

> A comprehensive course directory and learning platform offering curated training across business, design, and specialized certifications like FAA Part 107 drone pilot licensing.

Internet Of Learning aggregates and catalogs professional development courses with skill-level filtering and multi-language support. The platform specializes in business education, creative design training, and specialized certifications, serving learners seeking career advancement and skill development.

## Business Courses

- [Business](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business): Business courses and bootcamps for career advancement
- [Project Management](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/project-management): Project management courses for business professionals
- [Business Strategy](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/business-strategy): Business strategy courses and learning platform
- [Sales](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/sales): Sales training courses for business professionals
- [Entrepreneurship](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/entrepreneurship): Entrepreneurship courses for business skill development
- [Communication](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/communication): Business communication courses for skill development
- [Business Analytics Intelligence](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/business-analytics-intelligence): Business analytics and intelligence courses for education
- [Human Resources](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/human-resources): Human resources courses for business professionals
- [Business Law](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/business-law): Business law courses and legal education catalog
- [E Commerce](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/business/e-commerce): E-commerce business training courses and catalog

## Design Courses

- [Design](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/design): Design courses and bootcamps with expert-led instruction
- [Graphic Design Illustration](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/design/graphic-design-illustration): Graphic design and illustration courses catalog
- [3D Animation](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/design/3d-animation): 3D animation courses for design professionals
- [Game Design](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/design/game-design): Game design courses and learning platform
- [Design Tools](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/design/design-tools): Design tools courses for digital design professionals
- [Fashion Design](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/design/fashion-design): Fashion design courses for skill learning

- [Drone Pilots](https://internetoflearning.org/courses/drone-pilots): Drone Pilots course directory and catalog with skill filtering
